# Ramp

> > Ramp is a comprehensive spend management platform offering corporate cards, accounts payable automation, expense management, and treasury solutions powered by Ramp Intelligence.

Ramp provides finance automation tools for businesses to control spending, streamline procurement, automate accounting workflows, and optimize treasury management. The platform serves organizations ranging from startups to enterprises like Poshmark, Notion, and the University of Tennessee Athletics Foundation.

## Key Topics

- Spend Management
- Corporate Cards
- Accounts Payable Automation
- Expense Management
- Finance Automation
- Ramp Intelligence
- Ramp Treasury
- Procurement
- Business Travel Management
- Accounting Automation
- Treasury Management
- AP Solutions
- Financial Controls
- Expense Tracking
